profile.name: BITalino 生理信号采集板
profile.description: BITalino 是一款便携式蓝牙生理信号采集设备，提供多路模拟输入通道，可用于采集和传输实验中的生理或其他低频模拟传感器信号。它常用于教学、原型开发和可穿戴生理测量实验。
profile.description_en: BITalino is a portable Bluetooth biosignal acquisition device with multiple analog input channels for collecting and streaming physiological or other low-frequency analog sensor signals in laboratory experiments. It is commonly used for teaching, prototyping, and wearable physiology measurements.
